2020 is a leap year (February has 29 days).  
281 days from 2020-02-25:  
February: 4 days left (25 to 29 → 26,27,28,29).  
March: 31, April: 30, May: 31, June: 30, July: 31, August: 31, September: 30, October: 31, November: 30.  
Sum to end of November: 4+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30 = 279 days.  
279 days brings to 2020-11-30. Add 2 more days → 2020-12-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2020-12-02
